item.subject: science
item.chapter_label: Mindful eating: a path to a healthy body
item.stem: Meena's grandmother says, "Roti made from whole wheat atta and enough drinking water keep your body healthy, even though neither roughage nor water gives you nutrients like proteins or vitamins do." Which statement explains why roughage and water are still needed by the body?

options.A: Roughage helps food move through the gut and water helps absorb nutrients and remove waste, so both are essential even though they provide no nutrients.
options.B: Roughage and water are not needed because only components that give nutrients are useful to the body.
options.C: Roughage provides proteins and water provides vitamins, so both are needed as nutrients.
options.D: Only water is needed because it removes waste; roughage has no role and should be removed from the diet.
